svg.title: Holder Compliance Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-holder-compliance-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Holder Compliance Roadmap; subtitle: Four-week sprint from exposure review to audit posture; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Exposure Assessment; deliverable: Review receivable credit balances and the voided check register; stop sweeping stale items into miscellaneous income.; gate: Voided and stale items flagged before they age into unclaimed property within three to five years.; week: Week 2; title: Due Diligence Letters; deliverable: Send South Carolina letters on items of $50 or more no more than 120 days before filing; apply the Texas $250 notice floor.; gate: Texas July 1 and Utah November 1 report deadlines calendared.; week: Week 3; title: Exemption Review; deliverable: Screen recoupment, business-to-business, and de minimis exemptions; Kodiak counts about 100 in healthcare.; gate: Compliant but not overly compliant before remitting.; week: Week 4; title: Audit and Disclosure Posture; deliverable: Decide on any Delaware VDA invitation within 90 days; voluntary disclosure cuts look-back to about ten years and waives penalties.; gate: Participating-state list pulled from state notifications, never from the auditor.; caption: Non-filing, missing property types, and M&A trigger audits; Tennessee penalizes willful failure at $1,000 a day up to $25,000 plus 25%.; assumptions note: The four-week cadence is an organizing frame; deadlines, floors, and penalties are as stated by the named examiners and advisors.; note: Attributed to TNTreasury; Utah Office of State Treasurer; SimekScott LLC; Friedman LLP; Kodiak Solutions; COMPUTERSHARE (Pam Wentz, Jennifer Borden).
